name: ui/review
title: Review a page's UI
summary: Check a web page's UI: phone width, contrast, keyboard focus, states and overflow, with a fix for each finding.
when: Use when the user wants a web page checked for phone layout, contrast, keyboard focus, states or overflow.
steps: Call glob_files with **/*.html to find the page and call read_file on it; when no page is found, say so and ask for the file's path.
Call read_file on each CSS file the page links, and read the rules that set width, max-width, padding and font-size.
Call grep_files with @media and max-width over the CSS to see whether a phone breakpoint exists and what it changes.
Call grep_files with color and background over the CSS, then compare each text colour with the background behind it for 4.5:1.
Call grep_files with focus and focus-visible to check that every button, link and input has a visible focus style.
Call grep_files with overflow, white-space and width to find rules that could push the page wider than a phone screen.
Read the HTML for loading, empty and error states, and list a state that is missing rather than assume it works.
Answer with each finding at its file and line plus the exact fix, and say which checks the files alone could not settle.
next: The final answer must list each finding with its file and line and the exact fix, and say which checks the files alone could not settle.
